result.instructions: Tools for AssemblyAI, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Transcribe this recording: https://example.com/call.mp3 and tell me when it is ready."; "Show the transcripts that finished today."; "Give me the paragraphs of my last completed transcript, with speaker labels.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AssemblyAI data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run assemblyai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run assemblyai_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run assemblyai_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. assemblyai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: assemblyai_list_transcripts
tools.title: List transcripts
tools.description: List transcripts on the account, newest first, with id, status, creation time and audio URL. Use before_id or after_id with the last id to page. AssemblyAI API: GET /v2/transcript.

created_on.description: Only transcripts created on this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

before_id.description: Only transcripts created before this transcript id.

after_id.description: Only transcripts created after this transcript id.

throttled_only.description: Only transcripts that are throttled (ignores status).

tools.name: assemblyai_get_transcript
tools.title: Get a transcript
tools.description: Get one transcript: status, full text, words with timestamps and confidence, utterances (speaker turns when speaker labels were on), and any requested analysis results. A transcript is ready when status is completed. AssemblyAI API: GET /v2/transcript/{id}.

transcript_id.description: The transcript id (from assemblyai_list_transcripts or assemblyai_submit_transcript).

tools.name: assemblyai_get_transcript_paragraphs
tools.title: Get transcript paragraphs
tools.description: Get a completed transcript split into paragraphs, with start and end times and speaker where available. AssemblyAI API: GET /v2/transcript/{id}/paragraphs.

transcript_id.description: The transcript id (from assemblyai_list_transcripts or assemblyai_submit_transcript).

tools.name: assemblyai_get_transcript_sentences
tools.title: Get transcript sentences
tools.description: Get a completed transcript split into sentences, with start and end times and speaker where available. AssemblyAI API: GET /v2/transcript/{id}/sentences.

transcript_id.description: The transcript id (from assemblyai_list_transcripts or assemblyai_submit_transcript).

tools.name: assemblyai_get_transcript_subtitles
tools.title: Get transcript subtitles
tools.description: Get a completed transcript as subtitle text in SRT or VTT format. AssemblyAI API: GET /v2/transcript/{id}/srt or /vtt.

transcript_id.description: The transcript id (from assemblyai_list_transcripts or assemblyai_submit_transcript).

tools.name: assemblyai_search_transcript_words
tools.title: Search words in a transcript
tools.description: Count where given words or phrases occur in a completed transcript, with the timestamps of each match. Phrases cannot contain commas. AssemblyAI API: GET /v2/transcript/{id}/word-search.

transcript_id.description: The transcript id (from assemblyai_list_transcripts or assemblyai_submit_transcript).

tools.name: assemblyai_submit_transcript
tools.title: Start a transcription
tools.description: Start a transcription job for a publicly reachable audio or video URL. Returns the transcript id with status queued; poll assemblyai_get_transcript until the status is completed. AssemblyAI bills the audio processed. AssemblyAI API: POST /v2/transcript.

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio or video file.

language_code.description: Language code such as en_us or de. Leave empty to use the default.

speech_models.description: Speech models in priority order. Leave empty for the account default.

speaker_labels.description: Label speaker turns (diarization). Speakers are not identified by name.

format_text.description: Format text with capitals and numbers.

redact_pii.description: Redact personal information from the text.

redact_pii_policies.description: PII types to redact, such as credit_card_number.

prompts.description: Count where given words or phrases occur in a completed transcript, with the timestamp of each match. Phrases cannot contain commas.
